notes.title: Post Void is in Difficult Games Bash!
notes.content:
Heeelloo, it’s us again, YCJY: christopher and josef! it’s been some time since we did anything Post Void-related as we’ve been busy working on Keep Driving the last few years. Nothing new in the game per say, but we’re is participating in this week’s Difficult Games Fest with a lot of other great games.

[h3]Post Void 20% off[/h3] 

The event is happening here on Steam from [i]October 28 to 31[/i]. It’s the celebration of difficulty and challenge, that hopefully leads to flow and ecstasy. For those of you who have already played Post Void, we imagine you’ll agree with the assessment…

If you haven’t played Post Void already: why not?[u] It's cheap and distills the fast paced fps genre to its core. [/u]speed is your friend, time is your enemy. It’s hypnotic, francis bacon inspired color palette, and even a monthly leader board where you might have a chance to reach the top 10. 

[i]Oh and Our new game [b]Keep Driving[/b] is also on this festival... it's not difficult unlesss you down a bottle of wine, have a bad relationship with your parents, and spend all your money on cigarettes while on your road trip. 
[/i]
For the latest of what we’re up to, be sure to follow us on [url=https://x.com/YCJYgames]Twitter[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/j3zjBjR]Discord[/url]! See you around! :) 

p.s. we're so close to 10k reviews, so if you have played it please write a review! 
p.p.s. check out our friends' game Sulfur that just came out on early access today.

notes.title: KEEP DRIVING DEMO
notes.content:
[h3]Hi again everyone! Christopher and Josef here again. [/h3]

Firstly, a massive thank you to everyone for the feedback and such an amazingly positive reaction to Keep Driving. We have been completely blown away by your comments, especially on Twitter, where things [url=https://x.com/YCJYgames/status/1841466616992670034]absolutely blew up[/url]! Kotaku, Rock Paper Shotgun and PC Games even [url=https://kotaku.com/keep-driving-road-trip-sim-rpg-chill-steam-trailer-pc-1851671194?rev=1728679747622]gave us a shout out[/url] already!

[h3]You can watch the reveal trailer below if you missed it.[/h3]

Today, we're excited to let you get hands-on with our first-ever demo for the game. You’ll get a taste of things to come as you spend a weekend driving to your friend's house to play a video game, encountering hitchhikers, taking odd jobs, and keeping your vehicle running on the way. You’ll get a sneak peek into our procedurally generated world with its naturalistic pixel art, a couple of endings including a specially made main story for the demo, and an awesome but limited (for the demo) soundtrack by local indie bands Westkust and Crystal Boys!

We’d LOVE to hear what you think of the demo, so feel free let us know on [url=www.x.com/ycjygames]Twitter[/url], or join our [url=https://discord.gg/j3zjBjR]Discord[/url], which will become more active in the coming months. 

[previewyoutube=ag7Ss-Hxdw0;full][/previewyoutube]

Cheers!
Christopher & Josef

notes.title: POST VOID GAMEPAD UPDATE
notes.content:
We're happy to announce the release of Post Void 1.4.
This version of POST VOID adds some features that were created to the recently released console release of POST VOID.

[h2]UPDATE:[/h2]
[strike][b]It seems this build was somehow crashing for a lot of players. We have temporarily reverted back to the older version, but will try to resolve this asap. For now, if you want to try the new version you can choose the public beta-branch to access it.[/b][/strike]

[b]Build is now live again and should not cause crashes anymore. Sorry for the inconvenience![/b]


[h2]NEW FEATURES:[/h2]

[h3]GAMEPAD SUPPORT[/h3]
POST VOID now supports gamepad controls. We're very happy how the gamepad controls ended up and worked closely with porting developer Zach Reedy who did an amazing job with them. All buttons are rebindable and the game works perfectly on the Steam Deck. (Verification on deck should soon be approved, but it works very well already)

[h3]LOCALIZATION[/h3]
New languages are now available in the options menu, the following languages are available:
- English
- French
- Spanish
- German
- Dutch
- Korean
- Japanese
- Traditional Chinese
- Simplified Chinese
- Arabic
- Russian

Thanks to Super Rare games for letting us use the localization for the console version for STEAM.
Extra thanks to Isla Pleasure Partridge for the Russian translation and Malek Al-R. and Montassar Ghanmi for the Arabic localization.

[h3]MONTHLY LEADERBOARDS[/h3]
As an extra little feature we decided to add Monthly leaderboards to POST VOID. These will be reset at the start of every month. Looking forward to compete with everyone for the top spots every month!

[h3]IMPORTANT NOTES[/h3]
This new version should run better overall as it's been optimized very well. You might, however, notice that the game will start with the tutorial again and you will need to re-apply any settings you've set in the old version, as the saves are handled differently.
Don't worry about your high-score though. As long as you've [b]submitted to the leaderboard once[/b], your game will load your high-score from the steam servers and set it locally. [b]There is [u]no way[/u] for your score to be overwritten on the main leaderboard.[/b]

Thanks for everyone who plays and enjoys POST VOID
Cheers,
Christopher & Josef

[i]But, we shall remember:

Do not stare too deep
into that fair world
where desire is reality
and pain is unfurled
by the dripping

without your eyes
and without your voice,
without your lies
